suite: M10 inherited policy and final player controls
observations: Florence opens Economy, Credit and Lending & Investments normally, with separate bank and sovereign accounts.
On 1 April 1337, inherited policy -1 on an AI bank under a human controller correctly displays Investment mandate · manual; cash/assets/equity 5000 and zero offers/placements/recalls.
Normal Delegate investments displays delegated and leaves cash/assets/equity at 5000; the localized funding/consent tooltip is readable.

By 21 June 1337, normal monthly passes have made two demand placements. Cash 4706.39 plus the 200-gold receivable equals assets/equity 4906.39; the statement records two placements, zero offers and zero recalls. Native war/faction activity also occurred; this is not a profitability claim.
Normal Manage investments returns to manual with cash 4706.39, assets/equity 4906.39 and the 200-gold claim preserved; the tooltip explains continued servicing.
fixture_boundary: Starting cash, ownership and branch are explicit disposable setup. Other bank/company strategy is manual. No fixture action dispatches a strategy review, refills cash during observation or creates placements. Native gameplay continues. This focused controller presentation follow-up does not complete M10; independent-role acceptance retains its real earlier report.
